model.name: guard.failClosedOnVacuous
model.description: R-C3: every consistency guard is FAIL-LOUD (refuses with a named reason) AND FAIL-CLOSED on vacuous input (unresolvable/empty/0-items/wrong-ior/null/every([]) = REFUSE, never silent-pass). Generalizes the vacuous-pass fix the R-C7 BITE exposed into a cross-cutting invariant for EVERY S37 guard + a meta-BITE that gate-proves the gate-prover. Design design-rc3-fail-loud-guard.md.
